tool.name: ATRIUM Hugging Face models
tool.description: stages the Hugging Face models of the ATRIUM tools on the server

configfiles.configfile:
import json import re import shutil import sys from pathlib import Path
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
out_file, extra_files, model, value, name = sys.argv[1:6] repo_id, revision = model.split("@", 1) # The PyTorch weights in safetensors, the configs and the tokenizer; not the copies for other # runtimes (ONNX, OpenVINO, TensorFlow, Flax, Rust) nor the pickled duplicate of the weights. ignore = ["onnx/*", "openvino/*", "*.h5", "*.msgpack", "*.ot", "pytorch_model.bin", "*.onnx"] folder = Path(extra_files) / "model" snapshot_download(repo_id=repo_id, revision=revision, local_dir=str(folder), ignore_patterns=ignore) shutil.rmtree(folder / ".cache", ignore_errors=True) if not (folder / "config.json").is_file(): sys.exit(f"{repo_id}@{revision}: no config.json was downloaded") short = repo_id.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] value = re.sub(r"[^\w.\-]", "_", value.strip() or f"{short}-{revision[:7]}") name = name.strip() or f"{short} ({revision[:7]})" entry = {"value": value, "name": name, "repo_id": repo_id, "revision": revision, "path": "model"} with open(out_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: json.dump({"data_tables": {"atrium_hf_models": [entry]}}, handle) size = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in folder.rglob("*") if p.is_file()) print(json.dumps(entry), f"{size / 1e6:.0f} MB")

param.name: model
param.label: Model to stage
param.option: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2: KeyBERT in ATRIUM keyword extraction (about 0.5 GB)
Qwen2.5-0.5B: ATRIUM OCR line quality (about 1 GB)

param.name: value
param.label: Id of the entry
param.help: Empty: the model's name and the first seven characters of its revision, for example Qwen2.5-0.5B-060db64.

tool.help:
Downloads a model from the Hugging Face Hub once, at a pinned revision, into a folder that the ATRIUM tools read offline. Without it, every job of those tools downloads the model again.
- ``sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2``: KeyBERT, in *ATRIUM keyword extraction*. - ``Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B``: the perplexity model of *ATRIUM OCR line quality*.
Each entry of the ``atrium_hf_models`` data table is one model folder; each tool lists only the entries of its own model. Only the safetensors weights, the configs and the tokenizer are kept.
The tools run in containers: the destination that runs them must mount the data manager's data path (``galaxy_data_manager_data_path``) into the container, read-only.
Both models are Apache-2.0.
